steps.what: Negotiate shipping rates and service conditions with freight carriers within delegated authority

tasks.design: Keep carrier negotiation with the forwarder using {TELEPHONY}. The forwarder weighs price against actual capacity, service conditions and the commercial relationship; no automatic acceptance is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Negotiation concerns contingent commitments and trade-offs rather than a fixed rate lookup.
tasks.enabler_now: No evidenced change removes the negotiation itself.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain capacity, conditional offers and commitments beyond delegated limits.
tasks.human_edge: Reading the counterpart's constraints and deciding what concessions are worthwhile.
tasks.altitude: Negotiation responsibility and delegated financial limits remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess service conditions alongside a negotiated price
reach.learn: Capacity commitments, exclusions and delegated limits

evidence.claim: Carrier-rate negotiation remains contextual commercial conversation; no labour saving is asserted.

assumptions: Boundary is negotiation, excluding separate rate calculations, market research and contract administration. No administrative share is invented.

The customer supplies shipment needs and management supplies the existing mandate before negotiation. The carrier produces and changes offers during s1; clarification and any confirmation capture remain fully counted.
No structured accepted-offer flag or automatic commitment is assumed. Offers outside authority require the existing escalation process.
Use existing rate records before custom tools for a separately established preparation problem.
Zero incremental upkeep because negotiation practice remains unchanged.
research_questions: Is there measurable separate offer-comparison work that can be improved without claiming negotiation time?

already_counted.description: Negotiation, clarification and authorised commitment remain fully counted

incremental.description: No changed tool or procedure to maintain

approvals.approved_version: Exact carrier offer, price/currency, shipment scope, service conditions and delegated mandate at acceptance; changed terms require renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving 0. Scenario retains the actual commercial negotiation and does not assign savings from unrelated preparation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange special transport for sensitive cargo

steps.what: Clarify sensitive cargo requirements and verify the shipper's handling instructions
Assess carrier capability and agree suitable transport arrangements for the sensitive cargo
Prepare the carrier booking brief from the checked requirements and selected arrangement
Verify and issue the special transport booking and confirm carrier acceptance

tasks.design: Configure a booking template in {OPS_SYSTEM} that copies checked cargo requirements and the human-selected transport arrangement. The forwarder assesses capability and verifies the exact booking before sending it; software does not invent temperature, welfare or handling instructions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Checked special requirements may be copied repeatedly into a carrier booking.
tasks.enabler_now: A deterministic template can reuse confirmed fields and preserve the shipper's exact instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Cargo-specific suitability, exceptions and confirming that the carrier can actually meet the requirements.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising inadequate capability or unclear instructions and stopping the booking for clarification.
tasks.altitude: Less booking transcription is possible; the forwarder retains carrier selection and cargo suitability judgement.

reach.task: Prepare a verified special-cargo handover for execution

evidence.claim: A deterministic booking brief from checked requirements is plausible, but special-cargo judgement and local savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is arranging and booking special transport, excluding physical packing, monitoring cargo in transit and specialist instruction authoring.

The shipper's qualified cargo owner supplies existing handling instructions before s1. The forwarder checks and captures cargo identity, quantity, route, dates, required equipment and only expressly supplied handling conditions, instruction version and contact in s1; all capture and clarification remain counted.

Carriers supply existing capability evidence in response to enquiries during s2. The forwarder selects carrier, service and agreed conditions in s2 before s3. Missing requirements or unverified capability require manual clarification, never inferred safe conditions.
The carrier produces acceptance during s4 after the booking is issued. A changed condition voids the prior approval and requires renewed review.

Test native booking templates before custom code. Already generated bookings yield zero saving. Allow 6 focal hours per 100 baseline for template maintenance and booking exceptions; physical and supplier work is unchanged.
unknowns: Existing templates and actual transcription effort
research_questions: Does native brief generation save time after exact instruction review and carrier exception handling?

already_counted.description: Requirement capture and carrier suitability work remain counted
Booking verification and carrier acceptance handling remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain template and handle generation exceptions

approvals.approved_version: Exact booking version, carrier/service, cargo requirements, instruction attachments and recipient; any changed requirement or arrangement voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross saving 20 less 6 upkeep gives net 14. Range 1-8 assumes repeated booking transcription remains and sensitive-cargo exceptions consume part of the gain; capability assessment remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Arrange customs duties, taxes and paperwork

steps.what: Gather and check shipment documents and authorised customs instructions
Prepare clearance paperwork from checked shipment and customs arrangement fields
Review paperwork and arrange required duties, taxes or clearance steps through authorised parties
Confirm customs arrangement status and resolve missing documents or payment evidence

tasks.design: Use a native template in {OPS_SYSTEM} to prepare paperwork from checked shipment data and authorised customs instructions. The forwarder reviews the exact pack and coordinates duties or taxes with the authorised parties through {PARTNER_PORTAL}; no model determines liability, selects a tariff code or releases money.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same checked details may be copied into several clearance documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing transport and customs systems can reuse records and exchange structured documents.
tasks.still_hard: Missing evidence, unclear representation authority and changes to the underlying customs facts.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when instructions require specialist clarification and confirming actual arrangement status.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may prepare less duplicate paperwork while retaining review and customs-party coordination.

reach.task: Prepare a complete evidence pack for authorised clearance processing
reach.learn: Representation mandates, document requirements and status interpretation

evidence.claim: Portbase supports customs-document prenotification, import status and transit filing; this supports examining existing document exchange, not automatic tax judgement or the proposed local saving.

assumptions: Boundary is the forwarder's arrangements and paperwork, excluding specialist classification, declaration authority where held elsewhere, bank payment approval and customs release decisions. Existing specialist work is unchanged.

The shipper supplies shipment documents, the customer supplies the mandate and the authorised customs specialist supplies existing applicable instructions before s1. The forwarder checks and captures shipment ID, party IDs, goods references, values/currency, document references, instructed procedure, specialist-confirmed codes and any instructed duty/tax amount, currency and payment reference in s1; all capture time is counted.

No free structured tax amount or classification is assumed. Missing or conflicting instructions stop automatic preparation and require manual clarification. S2 copies confirmed facts and attaches source documents; it does not calculate liability.
The authorised representative produces responses after s3 before s4. The forwarder confirms status rather than treating message submission as clearance or payment completion.

Test native document reuse before custom integration. Existing automatic preparation earns no new saving. Allow 7 focal hours per 100 baseline for template upkeep and faults, plus 2 other-role hours for interface access and maintenance.
research_questions: Does native paperwork reuse save effort after mandate, instruction and document-version checks?

already_counted.description: Gathering, checking and missing-field capture remain counted
Paperwork review, arrangement and status exceptions remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain templates and resolve preparation faults

approvals.approved_version: Exact clearance pack, source versions, customer mandate, instructed amounts and recipient; any changed fact, amount or instruction voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross saving 25 less 7 focal upkeep gives net 18. Range 2-10 assumes duplicate paperwork today and substantial missing-instruction or document-version exceptions; specialist decisions and payments are not automated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inform clients about shipment options and constraints

steps.what: Check shipping options, timelines, transfers and applicable constraints for the client's shipment
Draft a client explanation from checked shipment facts and stated limitations

loop.purpose: Explain verified shipment options clearly without inventing commitments or regulatory advice
loop.input: Client enquiry and checked briefing facts with source references and limitations
loop.output: Draft explanation with source-linked statements and explicit uncertainties
loop.check: Forwarder checks service conditions, dates, transfer assumptions and limitations against supplied sources and rejects unsupported promises
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing or conflicting information returns to manual explanation or specialist referral
loop.why_not_simpler: Use fixed templates for routine notices first; varied questions and trade-offs may need bounded prose drafting

steps.what: Verify and deliver the client explanation and answer follow-up questions

tasks.design: Use a bounded loop in {DOCS} to draft an explanation from facts the forwarder has checked. The forwarder verifies the exact message before sending through {EMAIL} and handles follow-up personally, without turning estimated dates or guidance into guarantees.
tasks.previous_blocker: Explaining varied shipment choices repeatedly takes writing time, but sources must still be checked.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting from a constrained briefing pack is plausible with human meaning checks.
tasks.still_hard: Changing schedules, unclear constraints and distinguishing guidance from an authoritative decision.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the client's priorities and communicating what remains uncertain.
tasks.altitude: The forwarder may compose explanations faster while retaining factual responsibility and client dialogue.

reach.task: Explain a reviewed shipment option and its limitations
reach.learn: Source checking and escalation for unresolved regulatory questions

evidence.claim: Bounded drafting from checked shipping facts is plausible; its accuracy and net time saving for these enquiries remain unmeasured.

assumptions: Boundary is shipment explanation, excluding route selection, legal advice, booking and contract commitments.

The client produces the enquiry; carriers supply existing service information and the organisation's responsible specialist maintains approved guidance before s1. The forwarder checks applicability, source dates, shipment IDs, service options, estimated timelines, transfers and limitations in s1; all capture and checking time remain counted.

S2 receives the checked briefing facts, not an assumed perfect knowledge base. Missing support requires manual clarification or referral; model knowledge cannot supply a missing regulatory conclusion.
Input-pack preparation and draft correction are included in s2's retained time. The client produces follow-up questions during s3 after receiving the explanation.
Test existing templates before a custom loop. Allow 6 focal hours per 100 baseline for drafting instructions, stale-source checks and sample audits; no new uncounted specialist review is assumed.
research_questions: Does checked-source drafting reduce effort after unsupported promises and stale timeline statements are corrected?

already_counted.description: Facts and source applicability checks remain counted
Input preparation and draft correction remain counted
Final verification, delivery and follow-up remain counted

incremental.description: Maintain drafting instructions and audit source currency and explanations

approvals.approved_version: Exact client explanation, shipment/source snapshot, recipient and stated limitations; changed facts, commitments or recipient void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=88; gross saving 12 less 6 upkeep gives net 6. Range 0-4 assumes some repeated composition today, while source checking, complex questions and client dialogue remain fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Booking and clearance paperwork may require less copying, while negotiation, sensitive-cargo judgement and client responsibility remain human.
reach: Prepare complete clearance packs for authorised representatives
Provide planners with verified special-cargo handovers
skills_to_grow: Explaining uncertainties without making unsupported commitments
role.ambitious_version: Use clearer checked records and explanations to support difficult shipments without expanding authority over cargo safety, customs decisions or carrier commitments.
